reviewer.tool: captured PNG evidence and numeric Debug readback; local Symphony vision disabled

observations: The generated material-semantics fixture renders ten authored probes plus the separate mirrored-tangent and double-sided back-face probes. The Debug material records match the authored base color, metallic, roughness, normal scale, per-slot sampler/transform metadata, alpha mode, transmission and IOR values.

Numeric GPU readback proves the authored inputs reach the shader: shading-normal deviation from the geometric normal is 0.0 at normal scale 0, 0.0174 at 0.45 and 0.0494 at 1.0; the independent occlusion probe reads 0.19995 while the MR-red-only probe reads 1.0; the UV1 probe shows its authored factor (0.8/0.3/0.2) because the slot is unbound; the MASK probe keeps 0.35 coverage; IOR=1 reads transmission 0.0 and IOR=1.5 reads 0.9; the mirrored probe's perturbed normal differs from its geometric normal by 0.058; and the double-sided back-face probe's shading normal is exactly the reversed authored geometric normal (normal scale 0), proving front-face orientation rather than an eye-facing flip.

The import-isolation lane proves normalTexture.scale 0/0.45/1, independent occlusion in dependency slot 4, per-slot UV set/sampler/transform, the UV1 unsupported record, MASK cutoff and IOR=1 suppression without any GPU dependence.
The IOR=1 crew-suit pattern emits the explicit suppression compatibility record instead of silently dropping transmission; the authored OPAQUE alpha mode is preserved rather than rewritten to BLEND.

Car, Camera, Suit and microscope captures were re-run with the T22 material path. Car reports 139 materials with normal scales 0.3703/0.4495/1.0, 10 occlusion-bound materials and 23 transmissive draws; Camera keeps 1 transmissive material and its dark lens with reflection depth (reviewed nonregression); Suit keeps 14 materials with transmission suppressed at IOR=1; microscope remains visible with its known T23 ResourceLimit.
Car glass ordering/speckle and microscope complete-load readiness remain out of scope (T26/T27 and T23 respectively).

defects.label: reviewed-nonregression
defects.description: Camera lens remains dark with visible reflection depth; no regression from the T22 material changes.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Car windshield/side-glass ordering and speckle remain owned by T26/T27; T22 preserves the authored alpha/transmission inputs independently.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: The microscope can become visible before a terminal ResourceLimit; complete-load readiness is T23.

positives: Wire protocol v13, MaterialPayload 244 bytes, five material image slots and eight dependency slots are validated at the trust boundary.
The glTF importer preserves authored normal scale, per-texture UV set/sampler/transform metadata, independent occlusion, alpha mode/cutoff, transmission and unlit semantics.

The textured shader applies normal scale, per-slot transforms/samplers, independent occlusion, mirrored tangent handedness and front-face-aware TBN; the material record is now a per-material CBV (ADR-0080).
Derived-cache keys default to the real protocol/importer/material/vertex-layout identity.
UV1 references are left unbound with a specific compatibility record; MR red is never treated as AO.
